treatment.logline: A maker’s suspicion turns to quiet awe when a flickering desk lamp reveals it is syncing with a hidden prototype vibration beneath the workbench.
treatment.synopsis: In a dim, tool-lined workshop, a maker watches a matte-black lamp stutter in an impossible rhythm. After a sharp hook of dialogue, they test the surface, realizing the light isn’t malfunctioning—it’s mirroring the mechanical pulse of a concealed prototype. The tension dissolves into warm focus as the machine and lamp lock into steady sync.
treatment.visual_language: High-contrast practical lighting with shallow depth of field. Cool blue shadows give way to warm amber key light. Camera movements are deliberate, tactile pushes and low-angle slips that mimic human curiosity. Frame composition prioritizes hands, eyes, and light interaction over wide exposition.

acts.function: Hook, suspicion, physical realization, warm resolution

beats.action: Extreme close-up on MAKER’S eyes reflecting a matte-black desk lamp. The light stutters once against their pupils.
beats.audio_cue: Sharp electrical click, then half-second dead silence before dialogue cuts in tight.
beats.performance: Eyes widen slightly, voice drops to a compressed whisper, immediate suspicion snapping into hyper-focus.

continuity.wardrobe: Charcoal knit sweater, sleeves pushed to elbows

beats.action: Maker’s hand hovers over the workbench surface. The lamp flickers twice in quick succession.
beats.audio_cue: Low-frequency room tone builds, subtle metallic resonance underlies the flicker sounds; sharp inhale through nose.
beats.performance: Breath holds, shoulders tense forward, fingers twitch without touching anything, waiting for confirmation.

continuity.wardrobe: Charcoal knit sweater, sleeves pushed to elbows
continuity.screen_direction: Slow push-in on hands and lamp base

beats.action: Maker slides palm flat against the wood. The lamp’s strobe syncs to a hidden pulse beneath the grain.
beats.audio_cue: Dry wood scrape foley merges with a rhythmic, mechanical thrum; dialogue delivered on exhale.
beats.performance: Jaw unclenches, exhale sharp through nose, voice carries sudden relief mixed with awe as suspicion breaks.

continuity.wardrobe: Charcoal knit sweater, sleeves pushed to elbows
continuity.screen_direction: Cut to medium close-up, camera tilts down following hand

beats.action: Camera slips under the desk lip. Reveals a brushed-metal prototype housing vibrating visibly against a rubber mat. The lamp above stabilizes into a warm, steady glow.
beats.audio_cue: Mechanical hum softens to a smooth, resonant drone; ambient workshop noise fades out entirely.
beats.performance: Maker’s posture drops from defensive to open, shoulders relax completely as the reveal lands physically and emotionally.

continuity.wardrobe: Charcoal knit sweater, sleeves pushed to elbows
continuity.screen_direction: Low angle tracking shot sliding under desk lip

beats.action: Maker’s fingers rest lightly on the prototype casing. The light casts long, unwavering shadows across scattered tools.
beats.audio_cue: Deep breath out, faint metallic ping as fingertips make contact; drone holds steady under dialogue.
beats.performance: Voice is calm, grounded, carrying quiet triumph and warmth; delivery feels like a lullaby to the machine.

continuity.wardrobe: Charcoal knit sweater, sleeves pushed to elbows
continuity.screen_direction: Static medium shot, shallow depth of field focusing on hand/lamp glow transition

edit_plan.pacing: 2-4-3 seconds for SC_001 beats to build tension, then 5-4 seconds for SC_002 beats to release into warmth. Cuts land on action peaks and light transitions.
edit_plan.audio_strategy: Diegetic-first design: electrical clicks, wood foley, and mechanical thrum drive the narrative. Strategic silence after B01 hook amplifies curiosity. Drone fades out by B04 to emphasize physical reality over mystery. Dialogue sits dry and close-mic’d for intimacy.
edit_plan.transition_strategy: Match cut on light pulse from SC_001_B03 lamp sync to SC_002_B04 prototype vibration reveal. No dissolves or wipes; hard cuts maintain commercial urgency while preserving emotional continuity.
